<p>Trinity Washington University offers student-athletes the opportunity to compete at the NCAA Division III level while pursuing academic excellence at a university dedicated to service, justice, and empowerment.</p>
<p>Our Tigers compete in five varsity sports—basketball, lacrosse, soccer, tennis, and volleyball—playing their home games in the state-of-the-art Trinity Center for Women and Girls in Sports right here in the heart of Washington, D.C.</p>
